info.title: RAGLens Local API
info.description: Local-first API for inspecting RAG document ingestion, query runs, citations, evaluations, trace export, and portable run bundles.

get.description: Returns public health status. This route never requires an admin token.

Returns documents, previewable chunks, eval questions, summarized runs, provider status, and observability status for the requested project. When omitted, projectId uses the stable default project. Chunk embedding vectors and term-count internals are not included.

post.description: Rebuilds chunks and embeddings for every document in the active or explicitly targeted project using the current chunk settings. Existing run evidence snapshots are preserved.

200.description: Reindexed documents and public chunk previews

get.description: Returns in-memory queued, processing, completed, and failed ingestion jobs for the active or explicitly targeted project. Job payloads never include raw source text, PDF bytes, or embeddings.

post.description: Queues a document for dependency-free in-process indexing. Use POST /api/documents for synchronous indexing.

get.description: Exports staged retrieval, evidence provenance, generation, evaluation, privacy, and usage metadata. Raw content follows the configured OTLP content-export policy.

get.description: Downloads a JSON attachment with the inspected run, retrieved evidence chunks, source metadata, metrics, warnings, and review summary. Full source document text and embedding vectors are not included.
